description: An 8-channel digital logic analyzer for recording/inspecting signals during simulation (exports a VCD file); a debugging tool, not a functional circuit component.
how_to_use: D0-D7 are the 8 input channels (each independently named via the `channelNames` attribute), GND is ground — purely observes whatever signals are wired to it, never drives anything.

plain.what: A tool that records the on/off signals on up to 8 wires, so you can see what your circuit is really doing.
plain.how: Clip its wires to the signals you want to watch, and GND to GND, then look at the recording on your computer.
